Summary: No limit on repeated incorrect-password attempts
Actual Behaviour: Repeated wrong passwords do not trigger throttling or a temporary lock.
Why It Matters: Attackers can keep guessing passwords without restriction.

Summary: Login messages reveal whether an email is registered
Actual Behaviour: An unregistered email returns Please Enter valid Email ID. A registered email with a wrong password returns Please Enter valid Password.
Why It Matters: Because the two responses differ, anyone can test an address and learn whether it has an account on the portal. Combined with D-09, where password attempts are not limited, this gives an attacker both a list of valid accounts and unlimited attempts against them. Both failures should return the same message.
